parameters.name: AlarmMetadata
parameters.description:
The alert configurations for the service.

> This configuration takes effect only after an alert-related access policy is configured in \`PolicyNames\`.

parameters.name: ApprovalType
parameters.description:
The approval type for service usage requests. Valid values:

- Manual: The request requires manual approval.

- AutoPass: The request is automatically approved.

parameters.name: BuildParameters
parameters.description: The parameters for building the service.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. \`ClientToken\` supports only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: ComplianceMetadata
parameters.description: The compliance check metadata.

parameters.name: DeployMetadata
parameters.description: The deployment configuration of the service. The information stored varies by deployment type. Different deployment types have different data formats. The data is stored in a JSON string.

parameters.name: DeployType
parameters.description:
The deployment type. Valid values:

- ros: The service is deployed using ROS.

- terraform: The service is deployed using Terraform.

- ack: The service is deployed using ACK.

- spi: The service is deployed by invoking an SPI.

- operation: The service is an O\&M service.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform a dry run to check the request.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: The O\&M duration. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: IsSupportOperated
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable O\&M. Default value: false. Valid values:

- true: Enabled.

- false: Disabled.

> This parameter is required when \`ServiceType\` is set to \`private\`.

parameters.name: LicenseMetadata
parameters.description: The license metadata.

parameters.name: LogMetadata
parameters.description: The application log configuration.

parameters.name: OperationMetadata
parameters.description: The O\&M configuration.

parameters.name: PolicyNames
parameters.description: The policy name. The name of a single policy can be up to 128 characters in length. Separate multiple names with commas (,). Only policies related to O\&M parameters are supported.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: Resellable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the service can be distributed. Valid values:

- false: The service cannot be distributed.

- true: The service can be distributed.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: ServiceId
parameters.description: The service ID.

parameters.name: ServiceInfo
parameters.description: The service details.

sub_parameters.name: Agreements
sub_parameters.description: The information about the service agreements.

sub_parameters.name: Image
sub_parameters.description: The URL of the service icon.

sub_parameters.name: Locale
sub_parameters.description:
The language of the service. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US: English.

sub_parameters.name: LongDescriptionUrl
sub_parameters.description: The detailed description of the service.

sub_parameters.name: ShortDescription
sub_parameters.description: A brief description of the service.

sub_parameters.name: Softwares
sub_parameters.description: The information about the software used in the service.

parameters.name: ServiceType
parameters.description:
The service type. Valid values:

- private: The service instance is deployed in the user's account.

- managed: The service instance is managed in the service provider's account.

- operation: An O\&M service instance.

- poc: A trial service instance.

parameters.name: ShareType
parameters.description:
The sharing type. Valid values:

- Public: The service is public. Full and trial deployments are not restricted.

- Restricted: The service is restricted. Full and trial deployments are restricted.

- OnlyFormalRestricted: Only full deployments are restricted.

- OnlyTrailRestricted: Only trial deployments are restricted.

- Hidden: The service is hidden. It is not visible and you cannot request deployment permissions.

parameters.name: SourceServiceId
parameters.description: The ID of the source service for distribution.

parameters.name: SourceServiceVersion
parameters.description: The version of the source service for distribution.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The custom tags.

parameters.name: TenantType
parameters.description:
The tenant type. Valid values:

- SingleTenant: Single-tenant.

- MultiTenant: Multitenant.

parameters.name: TrialDuration
parameters.description: The trial duration. Unit: days. The maximum trial duration is 30 days.

parameters.name: UpgradeMetadata
parameters.description: The upgrade metadata.

parameters.name: VersionName
parameters.description: The version name.
